historical_claim_correction.current_truth: For shaping-script ZWJ graphemes with at least two visible Unicode Letter codepoints, the current implementation intentionally sums script-calibrated per-letter fallback floors to bound the browser no-ligature fallback path. That linear fallback is combined with the cluster minimum, per-character shaping widths and wide-letter floors via max(...).
historical_claim_correction.reason: The historical max-only/non-linear policy was later shown to permit hidden clipping when a client lacks the shaping font or ligature. The unicode-remediation functional head therefore introduced an intentionally linear conservative fallback. The historical receipt remains immutable as evidence of the prior accepted state, but its non-linear claim is not current semantic truth.
historical_claim_correction.stale_claim: shaping_script_zwj_budget_is_non_linear / shaping ZWJ clusters no longer sum isolated letter advances

disposition.evidence: The implementation is intentionally linear for the browser no-ligature fallback; the defect was the stale historical evidence claim that the current policy remained non-linear.
disposition.title: Linear shaping ZWJ inflation remains linearly scaled
